name: 73149 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73149 (Oklahoma City) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73149 (Oklahoma City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 73149 (Oklahoma City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
